purpose: Prove artifact absence or preservation through short visible cmd.exe operations before a model run begins.

retained_trials.finding: A wrapped conditional marker was not a reliable visible success proof.
An undefined percent-delimited variable remained literal in interactive cmd.exe instead of expanding to an empty string.
The percent-CD substring expression depended on a tilde that the raw VNC printer did not emit reliably.
set NAME= deletes the variable, so the later percent-delimited reference remained literal in this interactive shell.

retained_trials.method: Initialize PIKVMJOIN=X and render the marker through percent-PIKVMJOIN:X-equals-percent substitution.

observer_canaries.finding: The installed observer independently read the non-empty preserved canary.
The later diagnostic canary raced shell creation and was retained as zero bytes rather than promoted to proof.

finding: The final visible preflight no longer treats a requested rename as completed. It records readiness only after a separate visible absence or preserved-path marker is recognized.
